Troopers, forward!|Staz to his troops shortly before being killed in an explosion|}} '''Staz''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[major]] that served in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[224th Imperial Armored Division]]. He led the [[division]] during the [[Mimban Campaign]]. During a [[Battle on Mimban|battle]], he was [[Death|killed]] by an explosion as he yelled orders to his troops. ==Biography== ===Mimban campaign=== {{Quote|Solo, get up! We're almost there!''"
"''Almost where?|Staz, and Han Solo|}} Staz was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who, by [[10 BBY]], had achieved the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[major]] in the [[Imperial Military|Armed Forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] and was in command of the [[224th Imperial Armored Division]]. Staz led the [[division]] during the [[Mimban Campaign]] against the [[Mimbanese Liberation Army]], who were resisting Imperial advancements. [[File:SoloStaz-Solo1.jpg|thumb|left|Staz on Mimban]] During the campaign on [[Mimban]], Staz commanded his forces to capture a final ridge in their area in the bloody{{BustCollectionCite|51|Character}} [[battle on Mimban]].''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Meet the Crew]]'' After [[Corporal]] [[Han Solo]] had been blown to the ground by an explosion, Staz helped him recover and informed him that they were almost to their objective. When Solo replied with confusion on where they were headed, Staz stated that they were headed just over the final ridge. As Staz began to proclaim that victory was at hand, he failed to notice a [[missile]] inbound from the Mimbanese lines and was promptly blown to bits by it, dying instantly. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|AT-hauler. That's what we came for. Forward operations must be this way.''"
"''They are, but the major said we're supposed to go that way!''"
"''Yeah, go that way and die!''"
"''That's exactly what happened to the major!|Tobias Beckett to his crew, as Han Solo enters the conversation|}} Following his death, Solo was shocked and fell back to a trench, where he witnessed what appeared to be an [[Imperial officer]], who would in actuality be [[Tobias Beckett]] with the [[Imperial military uniforms|uniform]] of a [[captain]], who was on Mimban attempting to [[Thief|steal]] a [[Y-45 armored transport hauler]] for a [[heist on Vandor]]. While Beckett was speaking with [[Beckett's gang|his crew]], Solo joined into the conversation to inform him that Staz had ordered them to go the other way. Beckett responded by telling Solo to go that way and die, in which Solo responded by saying that that's what happened to Staz. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Where are we going?''"
"''Just over that last ridge. Victory is…|Han Solo, to Staz just as he was killed|}} Staz was a human male who had [[Color|dark]] [[hair]] and light skin. Despite being a major, Staz led his forces on the front lines of heated combat, and in at least one example, helped a subordinate recover and motivated them to continue forward. However, his zeal for combat and rallying his troops in the name of the Empire caused him to be neglectful of his surroundings and he thus failed to notice a missile heading straight for him until it was too late to get out of the way. ==Skills and abilities== During intense combat, Staz was able to direct his subordinates and wield a [[E-10 blaster rifle]]. ==Equipment== As an [[officer]] of the Galactic Empire, Staz was equipped with an officer's uniform with a type of fitted, waterproof greatcoat and a [[plastoid]] chestplate [[armor]] piece. He also wore an unarmored cap and used a [[blaster]] [[rifle]] in combat. ==Appearances== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation 1|''Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation'' 1]] ==Sources== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' {{1stID|Staz}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Core Worlds, Colonies, the Inner Rim and Expansion Region}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Staz |fr=Staz |ja=スタッツ |ka=სტაზი |pl=Staz |tr=Staz |uk=Стаз }} [[Category:224th Imperial Armored Division personnel]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Army officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Majors]] [[Category:Males]]
